title: Freight Claim Log Form
subtitle: Freight Claim Intake: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Freight Claim Log Form covers claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation. The freight claims coordinator records Freight Claim Intake events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Freight Claim Log Form keeps Freight Claim Intake exceptions visible until the freight claims coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Freight Claim Log Form at origin, transit custody points, destination, inspection location, and evidence repository. Document claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation identity before Freight Claim Intake begins. Compare claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation findings with stated Freight Claim Intake criteria; route unresolved Freight Claim Intake issues to authorized claims reviewer. For Freight Claim Log Form, confirm requirements for Freight Claim Intake. Ask authorized claims reviewer to review Freight Claim Intake conditions beyond the freight claims coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking variance reference and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Freight Claim Intake, identify responsible parties, origin, transit custody points, destination, inspection location, and evidence repository, and the linked claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation source.

fields.label: Claim, bill, shipment, order, and invoice
Item, lot, serial, package, quantity, and amount

sections.title: Status variance and accountable response
sections.guidance: Capture Freight Claim Intake facts for claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Freight Claim Intake tracked controls
items: Loss, damage, delay, or expense allegation
Mitigation, salvage, repair, and retained goods
Notice, document completeness, and investigation owner

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: Keep the Freight Claim Intake chronology intact through handoff. State the unresolved exception, the owner selected by Freight Claims Coordinator, and the next control point.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Intake treated as liability or payment decision
Bill, invoice, packing, and delivery documents
blocks.guidance: Pause Freight Claim Intake when claim identity, determinable amount, evidence preservation, notice, or authorized investigation remains unresolved. Retain the available Freight Claim Intake proof and route unresolved claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation scope to freight claims coordinator.
